verdict.rationale: Decagon's Testing & QA product describes 'Simulations' that validate agent behavior 'before deploying to production and with every subsequent update' (decagon-docs-29) and Duet-generated test suites (decagon-docs-11), implying a pre-production testing environment. However, there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated sandbox with isolated/non-production data, and the Experiments feature explicitly runs live in production (decagon-docs-7), which cuts against a clear sandbox-vs-production separation. Missing for 10: explicit description of sandbox data isolation, confirmation that test/simulation environments don't touch live customer data, and independent verification of this claim.
